cutoff_audit.scan_rule: Each Parquet scan applied its own event-time predicate < 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z before conversion to pandas, projected only required columns, then asserted max(event_time) < cutoff. The canonical full-window runner was not invoked.

features.available_timestamp: bar open_time + 8h; included only when <= decision_time
features.endpoint_archive: data.binance.vision USD-M monthly klines, 8h; frozen bars.parquet
features.event_timestamp: open_time (bar interval starts); close event is open_time + 8h
features.lag: latest input is the bar ending at t; fill open stamped t is hidden
features.missing_behavior: no forward fill or interpolation; current 72h exact-grid failure excludes symbol; a prior pair is skipped and fewer than 48 valid values among the prior 60 excludes the symbol
features.transformation: nine adjacent log returns on an exact ten-close 72h grid; displacement divided by realized root-sum-square; prior-60-day median/MAD z-score using observations strictly before t

features.available_timestamp: funding_time, admitted only when funding_time < decision_time
features.endpoint_archive: data.binance.vision USD-M monthly fundingRate; official /fapi/v1/fundingRate only for frozen archive gaps
features.lag: strictly earlier than t; a boundary event at t is excluded from the signal
features.missing_behavior: sum actual events; no-event window is zero only after the first observed event; pre-first-event is missing; snapshot coverage failure is not repaired
features.transformation: 72h cumulative rate on [t-72h,t); prior-60-day past-only median/MAD z-score; daily cross-sectional Theil-Sen residual

features.available_timestamp: after the valid cross-sectional fit at daily decision t
features.endpoint_archive: derived only from the contemporaneous past-only FPEG residual cross-section
features.lag: Q33/Q67 are computed from valid D_s with s<t only; D_t is appended after sizing
features.missing_behavior: invalid cross-sectional fit requests flat and appends no D; valid D is appended even if a later allocation-feasibility gate requests flat
features.transformation: 1.4826 times cross-sectional MAD of residuals; most recent L=180 prior values; nearest-rank 33rd/67th percentiles; current-in-history flag is binding false

features.available_timestamp: Monday 00:00 UTC reconstitution, then current decision intersection with executable opens
features.endpoint_archive: frozen membership.parquet derived from prior 30 complete days of Binance 8h quote volume and contract metadata
features.lag: ranking uses only completed dates before reconstitution
features.missing_behavior: never substitute a survivor or ineligible symbol; insufficient executable cross-section requests flat

features.available_timestamp: ex post at its timestamp; never passed as a feature
features.lag: future relative to the decision feature set
features.transformation: next-open fill and 24h forward research label log(O[t+24h]/O[t]) only; label interval [t,t+24h]

features.available_timestamp: prior completed 24h for participation; funding event for cashflow; exact boundary for mark risk
features.endpoint_archive: frozen bars.quote_volume, funding.mark_price, and boundary mark_prices
features.missing_behavior: fail closed; never imputed by strategy
features.transformation: participation cap, risk marks, actual funding, fees and slippage; not signal inputs
